topic: Types of APIs (REST, GraphQL, SOAP, WebSockets)
caption:
Every software engineer needs to know this... 👇

APIs are the glue of the modern internet. But not all APIs are created equal. Are you still using REST for everything? 

Here is a quick breakdown:
👉 REST: Good for standard CRUD ops.
👉 GraphQL: Perfect for fetching exactly what you need (no over-fetching!).
👉 SOAP: The old reliable for high-security enterprise apps.
👉 WebSockets: Essential for real-time chat and trading apps.

Stop defaulting to REST when GraphQL or WebSockets might be better for your architecture.

Which API style do you use the most in your current project? Let me know below! 👇
